newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 22.
newsitem.headline: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 22.

text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuania's parliament is reading the law on restitution of real estate to former owners today. The dwellers of the houses to be returned rally in front of Seimas in protest.

- Lithuanian frigate Zemaitis departed from Klaipeda port today to participate in an annual military exercise under the auspices of NATO's partnership for peace prgramme which starts in Geteborg on Friday.
- Lithuanian and Russian border guards have imposed stricter control on the border between Lithuania and Russia's Kaliningrad region in an effort to stem an increase in amber smuggling
